analysis.summary: Acme's onboarding package is mostly unanswered. The only Acme-specific configuration is a DRAFT proposal (persistence in AWS ca-central-1, OpenAI primary, Anthropic fallback intended off, app logs intended 14 days). It is explicitly not proof of deployed state. Main blockers: Legal says the DPA is blocked until subprocessors and cross-border transfers are confirmed; inference location and retention for prompts, responses, traces and source files are not established; the pen test Medium findings have no remediation evidence; the insurance certificate expired Oct 1, 2026 with renewal pending; and the SOC 2 report itself is not in the folder. Rows Q-024 to Q-060 have no real control definitions, so they are grouped into one clarification request. Priority next steps: get Anthony to confirm the deployed configuration, get Mina to confirm the subprocessor and transfer position, get Sam to provide the renewed insurance certificate, and ask Nina's team to decide synthetic vs real transcripts.
